failure.reason: missing buildings.geojson triggered live Overpass download attempts during offline C0 regeneration

behavior: Use existing local buildings.geojson when present.
Skip building GeoJSON download in settings.OFFLINE_ONLY or UP_OFFLINE_ONLY.

escalate_to_claude: Set UP_OFFLINE_ONLY=1 on the next C0 rerun so no network attempt can enter the provenance path.
